propositions: The inbound fetcher currently resolves only one query_project and runs a single JQL pair with one enrichment pass, silently dropping parent/comment/issuelink data for all other configured projects in the store mapping.
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project or repos fields because the fetcher has no visibility into which project each ticket came from.
The solution fans out JQL queries and all three enrichment passes (parent, comment, issuelink) per configured project, merging results into a shared snapshot deduped by seen_keys.
The per-query truncation ceiling (_ACLI_CEILING) is scoped per project, preventing one busy project from exhausting a shared budget.
A new helper resolve_inbound_bridge_fields derives the source project from the jira-key prefix and resolves the repos list from the project mapping, stamped into CREATE events.
Single-project (unseeded mapping) behavior is byte-for-byte identical to pre-change behavior by falling back to the original single-project code path.
